ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; flag the driver's account for pressing "I'm Here" while GPS shows he was ~690 m from the pickup point, and review the arrival-button abuse + flag_account

rejected_claims.reason: GPS trace shows the driver never entered the pickup point's 200 m radius; he was stationary ~690 m away (≈1.30398, 103.85835 vs pickup 1.2994, 103.8555) from 12:06:00 to cancellation at 12:09:05, so NS-1(ii)/(iii) are not met and the no-show claim fails. System GPS overrides the driver statement.
